dataset: Locally generated MetaWorld v3 rollouts; frozen V-JEPA 2.1 ViT-L feature cache

estimates.eta_basis: 552 dense episodes/hour; 3012 dense episodes remaining and 6400 goal-only candidates; sampled rendering 20.75-21.13 seconds/episode on four workers. Excludes training and evaluation, task variation and interruptions can change ETA.

implementation_findings: Four processes, one per GPU, each serially simulates/renders, encodes and writes an episode.
Frozen encoder batch size is two; bfloat16 inference, existing float16 stored features, lossless HDF5 compression.
Mesa llvmpipe software renderer, two threads per worker.
No producer-consumer overlap or asynchronous file writer.
Test candidate collection renders all 201 frames despite retaining initial/goal images only.
Largest fitting batch is not necessarily fastest; output-equivalence checks are needed before claiming larger batches are lossless.
render_probe_notes: CPU-only seeded test-goal collection, 201 RGB frames per episode, two successful episodes; first three-task aggregate probe timed out at 55 seconds and was not used for timing estimates.
scope: Read-only operational audit and CPU rendering probes; live execution source, precision, data protocol, methods and budgets unchanged.
